provenance.paper_title: EchoVLA: Robotic Vision-Language-Action Model with Synergistic Declarative Memory for Mobile Manipulation

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: A key-value voxel bank aggregates PointAttn features by 3D location and retrieves top-k local-frustum entries for coarse attention.

evidence.section: Full paper: Memory Retrieval and Interaction
evidence.paraphrase: A fixed-size FIFO buffer stores recent unified language, vision, point-cloud, and proprioceptive token sequences with timestamps for fine-grained retrieval.

High-discrepancy voxel regions are persistently updated by an exponential moving average while stable regions remain unchanged. For EchoVLA, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of persistent spatial-semantic voxel feature map.

The fixed-capacity FIFO buffer evicts oldest time-indexed token sequences as new states arrive. For EchoVLA, this specifically supports explicit deletion or eviction of stored items of persistent spatial-semantic voxel feature map.

derived.hybrid_relation: Coarse scene-map features and fine-grained episodic tokens are separately retrieved and fused by cross-attention to condition the diffusion policy.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 7): During inference, the operative memory component (persistent spatial-semantic voxel feature map) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
